messages:
Elan: Quick design sync on the compact Rollouts timeline. Two urgent items: keyboard focus order is confusing and the active version isn't read by screen readers.
Marta: I repro'd with VoiceOver it only announces 'group'. The visible dot has no accessible name.
Tyler: Proposal: make each version a focusable button (aria-pressed for active). Add an aria-live region that says 'Selected version vX.Y.Z, released DATE' when focus changes.
Marta: Also add a hidden 'Skip to latest version' link for keyboard users so they don't tab through dozens.
Asha (PM): Copy: change rollback CTA from 'Rollback' to 'Rollback to vX.Y.Z' and show a one-line truncated changelog on hover. Ops asked to use 'Released' instead of 'Deployed' in compact views.
Tyler: Visual: tiny dots fail contrast. accessibility-bot suggests either brand accent color or keep dot but add 24px hit target + focus ring and an outline on keyboard focus.
accessibility-bot: Scan: current dots = 2.1:1. Recommend >=3:1 or increase hit target; debounce aria-live updates (~300ms); test NVDA+Chrome and VoiceOver.
Elan: Modal copy for pausing canary: Title 'Pause canary?', body 'Pausing stops new traffic to this version while retaining metrics. To rollback completely, use Rollback.' Buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Pause' (destructive on right).
Marta: Keyboard handlers: arrow keys to move, PageUp/PageDown to jump snapshots, announce deltas in aria-live. Ensure any shortcuts use modifiers (Ctrl/Cmd) to avoid conflicts.
Tyler: I'll PR a small markup + CSS sketch: list role, per-version buttons, sr-only announcer, skip link, focus ring and hidden hitboxes.
Asha (PM): Actions: Tyler -> PR (EOD); Marta -> doc copy updates; Elan -> schedule staging a11y pass. Close once PR is open. :thumbsup:
